name: tallyline
description: Open-source web analytics that shows revenue next to traffic: which tweet, Google search, newsletter or AI chat (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) brought each paying customer. Goals, funnels and full buyer journeys, self-hosted free on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply tallyline --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.demo-data: node scripts/demo-data.mjs && wrangler d1 execute tallyline --local --file .wrangler/demo.sql
